instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-06_input.step. On the 130 x 90 x 10 mm base plate, add and fuse four cylindrical bosses and one raised center pad. The bosses are: diameter 20 height 14 at (25,25), diameter 24 height 12 at (105,25), diameter 18 height 20 at (25,65), and diameter 22 height 16 at (105,65), all starting on Z=10. Add a rectangular raised pad spanning X=55..75, Y=37..53, Z=10..18. Cut through holes through each boss and the base with diameters 6, 8, 5, and 7 mm respectively. The boss at (25,25) has a top counterbore of diameter 14 mm and depth 5 mm; the boss at (105,65) has a top counterbore of diameter 16 mm and depth 4 mm. Cut a rectangular through slot through the raised pad and base spanning X=57..73 and Y=41..49. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-06_output.step. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH). In this image, use `/usr/lib/freecad/bin/freecadcmd-python3` for the FreeCAD command-line work in this task when working on `freecad_task-06_input.step`.
